item.title: From Great Ife to Global Impact: Celebrating Dr. Onikepe Owolabi in Nature Magazine!
item.description: Obafemi Awolowo University is thrilled to celebrate our distinguished alumna, Dr. Onikepe Owolabi, who was recently featured in the prestigious journal Nature as one of the women in science who inspire the world! Dr. Owolabi, currently the Vice-President for International Research at the Guttmacher Institute (NYC), is a high-profile icon shaping global health discourse.
